data.name: Anil
data.gender_notes: Anil is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit anila, 'air, wind', from the root an, 'to breathe'. Its root is Sanskrit anila (अनिल). A classical Sanskrit name for the wind god. Anil is a Sanskrit name meaning “Air; wind”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anil expresses “Air; wind”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit anila, 'air, wind', from the root an, 'to breathe'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anil total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
